questions.title: Frequently Asked Questions
questions.text: Didn't find the answer to your question? Go to the FAQ page

q1.question: How do I start playing?
q1.answer: Create an account, choose a server, and connect using the IP address.

q2.question: Can I play on multiple servers?
q2.answer: Yes. One account works across LuckySurvival, MineWars, and CalmSky — switch anytime.

q3.question: Do you support Java Edition?
q3.answer: Yes. We support Java 1.20.4 and the latest Bedrock release.

q4.question: How do I contact support?
q4.answer: Use live chat, email, or Discord — our team replies in under 4 hours, around the clock.

q5.question: Are events free to join?
q5.answer: Yes. Tournaments and seasonal events are free for all players — no extra purchase required.
